trap.label: subjuntivo
trap.wrong: I insist that he is present at the meeting.
trap.right: I insist that he be present at the meeting.
trap.why: Em português “insisto que ele esteja” usa subjuntivo; o aluno traduz com indicativo. Em inglês, insist that + base.

mcq.q: “___ I known, I would have called.”
“If I had studied, I ___ a doctor now.”

fix.wrong: It is high time we leave.
fix.right: It is high time we left.

fix.wrong: Were I know, I would call.
fix.right: Had I known, I would call.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Were: “If it were not for X, we would fail.”
rewrite.answer: Were it not for X, we would fail.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com It is high time: “We should leave now.”
rewrite.answer: It is high time we left.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com insist: “He must be present.” (I insist that…)
rewrite.answer: I insist that he be present.
